profile.headline: Principal Developer at PSEG
profile.summary:
.NET Developer, Deployment Lead, and a CMS consultant for 10 years. Very interested on content management systems, technical architecture and design, design patterns, development,  and writing C#, VB .NET, and PL/T-SQL code. 

Very interested working on new and challenging projects, learning new technologies, and applying new methodologies.

Specialties: Microsoft Technologies: Design, Implementation, and Integration
(.NET Framework 1.1/2.0/3.0/3.5/4.0, C#, VB.NET, SQL Server 2005/2008/2012, SSIS, SSAS, MOSS 2003/2007, SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013, Sitecore XP 8, Ektron CMS, ASP.NET 2.0/3.5/4.0, IIS 6/7, Windows Server 2003/2008/2012, Application Management, Application Configuration, and Application Deployment)

Other Technologies: jQuery, Telerik Control Suite, HTML 5, CSS 3, Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, Design Patterns, SCRUM, Test Driven Development (TDD), Bootstrap, Responsive UI Design, Akumina, Sharepoint Framework (SPFx)
